text:
Several studies have investigated muscle activation during performance of supersets that involve different but related areas of the body (triceps extension and bench press): Some report greater activation of the pectorals compared to a traditional training protocol (37), while others show similar EMG amplitudes between conditions (82, 88). Overall, it is difficult to reconcile the divergent findings between EMG studies on superset training; as such, conclusions about practical implications remain equivocal.

Superset training can alter training volume, which in turn can affect hypertrophy outcomes.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
